R17: matterPromiseDuties takes nowMs, the instant the duties are read as of; this module's clock when absent
R17: met_at is the as_of of the first reading of the unbroken met run that ends each occurrence's recorded transitions, the latest of those; never an instant of the derivation
R17: when all_met holds but met_at cannot be stated, met_at is null with met_at_why; met_at_why is absent when all_met is false
